t: Din mi shello badaq belel y"d
s: Din mi shello badaq belel y"d ubo d' seipim: mi sheshshakach o hezid velo badaq belel y"d — yibdoq beyom y"d leor hanner, vibarek "asher qiddeshanu bemitzvotayv vetzivvanu al biur chametz". Veachar habbediqa yebattel im adayin lo higgia shaa shishshit:

Abar kol yom y"d velo badaq — yibdoq betok happesach leor hanner, dehaynu mittechillat lel t"v ad sop yom tob haacharon, shehu yom echad beeretz yisrael ubaggola b' yamim, chayyab hu libdoq (miyyad beotah shaa shennizkar, ayyen siman tl"a) kekol mishpete habbediqa shennitbaaru siman tl"g. (A) veqodem habbediqa chayyab lebarek "al biur chametz". Apillu im kebar bittel kol chametzo qodem happesach sheeno metzuvveh lebaaro min hattora, mikkol maqom middibre soperim chayyab hu libdoq ulechappes acharayv ulebaaro min haolam legamre, shechasheshu chakamim im lo yibdoq vichappes acharayv lebaaro shemma yimtzaennu meelayv veyishkach veyoklennu. Abal beshaa shehu mechappes acharayv ap im yimtzaennu lo yishkach veyoklennu, shehare kol atzmo eno mechazzer acharayv ella kede lebaaro min haolam, veek yishkach issuro veyoklennu:

Ukeshehu bodeq umechappes achar hechametz beyom tob atzmo, ben beyom tob harishon ben beyom tob haacharon, apillu beyom tob haacharon shel galuyyot, umatza chametz bibdiqato — lo yigga bo, ella yikpeh alayv keli ad haereb, kede sheyyihyeh mekusseh min haayin velo yabo leekol mimmennu, velaereb yebaarennu, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"v, ayyen sham kol perate din zeh. (Abal beshabbat shebbetok happesach lo yibdoq kelal, sheen bediqa ella leor hanner, ubeshabbat asur letaltel et hanner, ayyen siman tm"d):

Abar kol haregel velo badaq — chayyab libdoq leachar haregel leor hanner, kede lebaer (min haolam legamre, al derek sheyyitbaer besiman tm"h) kol chametz sheyyimtza bibdiqato, shehu asur bahanaa mishshum sheabar alayv happesach, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tm"ch, veim lo yibdoq vichappes acharayv kede lebaaro — yesh lachosh shemma yimtzaennu meelayv veyishkach veyoklennu veal bediqa shelleachar haregel lo yebarek kelum, ki ek yebarek "vetzivvanu al biur chametz", vahare hu okel chametz. Umah shehu metzuvveh umechuyyab lebaer chametz zeh sheabar alayv happesach, eno ella mishshum chashash taqqala, shello yabo leoklo, abal habbiur hazzeh mitztzad atzmo en bo mitzva kelal, shehare ap im mashheh oto bebeto veeno mebaaro — eno ober al shehiyya zo mitztzad atzmah be"bal yeraeh" ub"bal yimmatze" apillu middibre soperim, ella shenniqra ober al dibre chakamim sheaseru leshahoto shello yabo lide mikshol akila. Abal im lo hayinu chosheshin sheyyabo lide mikshol — en bishhiyya zo mitztzad atzmah issur kelal, ulekak en lebarek al biur zeh (kemo shehammemit opot shennidresu, sheasur lehashhotan mishshum chashash taqqala, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman n"z, veen mebarek al biuran mibbeto). Mah sheen ken keshehu bodeq umebaer betok happesach, sheaz yesh babbiur mitzva mitztzad atzmo, shenneemar "tashbitu seor mibbattekem". Veim eno mebaaro — ober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veap im kebar bittel kol chametzo qodem happesach sheeno metzuvveh lebaaro min hattora, mikkol maqom kevan sheggazeru chakamim sheen bittul moil kelum mitteamim yeduim — hare chametz zeh keillu lo nitbattel, veober alayv be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze" middibre soperim, vegam yesh bo mitzvat "tashbitu" middibre soperim, ulekak mebarek "vetzivvanu al biur chametz".
